scope: Query-plan regression evidence for account logout expansion; not an end-to-end latency or production-capacity benchmark.

observations: Both plans use principal, exact epoch and cursor as index conditions. The deep page seeks past earlier sessions.
The statement includes child insertion and its foreign-key check; each sample is rolled back. Database cache state differs between samples.
Root creation performs one insert without enumerating sessions. Integration checks separately cover 206-session pagination, independent workers, rollback and retention.
No baseline runtime speedup is claimed. Representative queue throughput, contention, overload and end-to-end delivery latency remain unqualified.
